# Bookstore API

## books

- [books](groups/books.md): Browse and manage the catalogue
- [listBooks](operations/list-books.md): Returns every book in the catalogue.
- [createBook](operations/create-book.md): Adds a book to the catalogue.
- [deleteBook](operations/delete-book.md): Permanently removes one book from the catalogue.
- [getBook](operations/get-book.md): Returns one book by its identifier.
- [updateBook](operations/update-book.md): Replaces the mutable fields of one book.

## Schemas

- [Book](schemas/book.md)
- [BookList](schemas/book-list.md)
- [CreateBookRequest](schemas/create-book-request.md)
- [ErrorResponse](schemas/error-response.md)
- [Genre](schemas/genre.md)
- [PublisherInput](schemas/publisher-input.md)
- [PublisherOutput](schemas/publisher-output.md)
- [UpdateBookRequest](schemas/update-book-request.md)
